strings.name: Stuart Russell
strings.summary: Russell researches AI reasoning, learning and decisions and has taught at Berkeley for decades. With Peter Norvig he wrote Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach, a widely used textbook. He later focused on autonomous weapons and control of machine objectives, proposing uncertainty about human preferences. In 2026 he continued advocating limits on autonomous weapons; these risk assessments are research and policy positions.
